versions.subject: feat: updates and fixes
versions.detection:
selection_processes:
    Image|endswith:
        # Email clients
        - '\outlook.exe'
        - '\thunderbird.exe'
        - '\HxOutlook.exe'
        # Browsers
        - '\brave.exe'
        - '\chrome.exe'
        - '\firefox.exe'
        - '\iexplorer.exe'
        - '\microsoftedge.exe'
        - '\microsoftedgecp.exe'
        - '\msedge.exe'
        - '\opera.exe'
selection_ext:
    - TargetFilename|endswith:
        - '.docm'
        - '.dotm'
        - '.xlsm'
        - '.xltm'
        - '.potm'
        - '.pptm'
        - '.pptx'
    - TargetFilename|contains:
        - '.docm:Zone'
        - '.dotm:Zone'
        - '.xlsm:Zone'
        - '.xltm:Zone'
        - '.potm:Zone'
        - '.pptm:Zone'
        - '.pptx:Zone'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\outlook.exe", "*\\thunderbird.exe", "*\\HxOutlook.exe", "*\\brave.exe", "*\\chrome.exe", "*\\firefox.exe", "*\\iexplorer.exe", "*\\microsoftedge.exe", "*\\microsoftedgecp.exe", "*\\msedge.exe", "*\\opera.exe") TargetFilename IN ("*.docm", "*.dotm", "*.xlsm", "*.xltm", "*.potm", "*.pptm", "*.pptx") OR TargetFilename IN ("*.docm:Zone*", "*.dotm:Zone*", "*.xlsm:Zone*", "*.xltm:Zone*", "*.potm:Zone*", "*.pptm:Zone*", "*.pptx:Zone*")
